timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the world of sports and business, few people are better known than George Gillette.
You've owned many sports teams.
You also owned Vale.
And one of the things that you said when you took over Vale was it needed a world class
orthopedic capability.
And you tell the rest of the story from there.
Well, we were blessed to have this extraordinary resort, but the medical side of it, the hospital
was good and solid, but the orthopedic side of it wasn't up to the power for the kind of
opportunity that Vale presented.
And so I had a bad accident.
And Cindy Nelson introduced Rose and me to Dr. Mrs. Steadman.
And they couldn't have been more charming.
And they were on their way to the World Championships in 1987, I believe it was, in Austria.
And Dr. Steadman said, come see me in San Francisco at the airport.
I've got to go to the World Championships.
So Rose and I flew out to San Francisco.
He took one look at my knee and he said, we're going to Lake Tahoe.
And so he delayed his trip by a day and he operated on me.
And it changed my life because once I met that extraordinary gentleman and his lovely
wife and they had Rose stay with them as they have done so many of the patients over
the years.
And my knee got better and our relationship with the Steadman's continued to stay strong.
And so we started working and took me three years to convince them to consider coming
to Vale.
I remember asking Dr. Steadman one time, geez why don't you practice in San Francisco
or LA or Chicago?
And he said no because this being in South Lake Tahoe, sorts out who's serious about having
surgery and who's serious about their physical therapy after it.
That's what he told me.
And he didn't want to go anywhere and you got him to come here.
So how did that happen?
I believe that it was, we were prepared to assist him in fulfilling his research dreams.
We had an opportunity here to build a very, very serious world-class research facility.
We started on it.
He had a dream.
We had a dream and we shared that dream and it worked out.
Lots of legends in the history of Vale, Colorado.
Where do you place Dr. Richard Steadman among that hierarchy of people who've made this
place great?
Well, I mean it's somewhere near the top.
When I say near the top, I think he would be one of the five folk up there along with
the crew, Pete Sibert and Earl Eaton and Dr. Steadman.
We've had some wonderful, wonderful luck having great people who have been here, supported
Vale and Beaver Creek.
Really better for us, nobody better for the profession of skiing than Dr. and Mrs. Steadman.
Unfortunately for all of Vale and skiers from all over the world, Georgia let remains as
a leader on the Steppenfield Pond Research Institute Board and has ensured that this tradition
continues and the excellent care that Dr. Steadman pioneered is available to everyone with
those who are part of his team now.
Thank you Greg.
Delightful to talk to you.
Thank you, Georgia.

youtube_description:
Greg Lewis talks to George Gillett about his history with Dr. Richard Steadman at the Grateful Steadys event on December 3rd, 2016.

http://www.SPRIVail.org
http://www.TheSteadmanClinic.com

The Steadman Philippon Research Institute  is dedicated to keeping people of all ages physically active through orthopaedic research and education in the areas of arthritis, healing, rehabilitation, and injury prevention. 

Founded in 1988 by orthopaedic surgeon Dr. J. Richard Steadman, the Steadman Philippon Research Institute is an independent, tax-exempt (IRS code 501(c)(3)) charitable organization, employing scientists, researchers, fellows, visiting scholars, and interns.

The Steadman Philippon Research Institute is known throughout the world for our research into the causes, prevention and treatment of orthopaedic disorders. We are committed to solving orthopaedic problems that limit an individual's ability to maintain an active life.

Our research perspective is based on clinical relevance, with a goal of improving the care of the patient. Recognizing that the body's innate healing powers can be harnessed and manipulated to improve the healing process has led to exciting advances in surgical techniques, such as microfracture and innovative rehabilitation developed by Dr. Richard Steadman, and validated at our Institute. Today, the Institute is recognized worldwide for Dr. Marc Philippon’s pioneering research for the treatment of sports related injuries to the hip.
